ui.adminRegionChangeConfirm: Changing the region may remove properties outside the new area. Continue?

ui.adminLargeRegionWarning: Large region — ingest may take ~{minutes} minutes.
ui.adminGeofabrikWarning: Geofabrik import — downloads ~{mb} MB extract. Requires osmium-tool on the server (Docker dev image includes it).

ui.adminEstimatesDisclaimer: Estimates only — actual values may differ
ui.adminExportAuditedLead: Moving to a new area requires exporting audited field work first (auditor facts and submissions only). This is smaller and safer than a full backup — re-import merges into the new region by OSM ID.
ui.adminExportAuditedNote: Full backup (below in Admin) includes auditor data too, but restore replaces the entire database — do not use it for a region move.
ui.adminExportConfirmCheckbox: I exported audited data and understand properties outside the new region will be removed
ui.adminSaveRegionOnlyHint: Use Save region only when you plan to import via Docker CLI (osm-import-pbf) or GeoJSON upload — skips the Admin ingest job.
ui.adminRegionUnchangedHint: Region bbox is already saved. Use Re-ingest to download OSM data for this area.
ui.adminImportGeoJsonDesc: Load accommodations from a pre-exported GeoJSON or geojsonseq file (e.g. from osmium), clipped to the current region bbox. This is an OSM data source, not a backup or restore of node data.
ui.adminReimportAuditedDesc: You moved to a new region. After OSM ingest finishes, upload the Export audited data JSON to re-attach field audits (matched by OSM ID). Merges into existing properties — unlike full backup restore.
ui.adminWaitForIngest: Wait until the OSM ingest job completes before importing.
ui.adminConfirmExportFirst: Confirm you exported audited data before continuing.
ui.adminRegionUnchanged: Region unchanged. Use Re-ingest to download OSM data again.
ui.adminMapDrawHint: Hold Shift and drag on the map to draw your region. Without Shift, drag pans the map.
ui.adminMapBboxInvalid: Region exceeds tile limit — draw a smaller area.
ui.adminBackupLead: Full-node snapshot: all properties, facts (OSM and auditor), audit submissions, peers, region settings, and OSM sync state.
ui.adminBackupRestoreSuffix: that data — always download a backup first.
ui.adminBackupUseForDesc: disaster recovery, cloning this node, or migrating to another server

ui.adminBackupExcludesDesc: user accounts — export those separately in Users below
